board: Delaware Board of Accountancy (Division of Professional Regulation)

cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Delaware permits expire June 30 of odd-numbered years. Each period needs 80 hours, at least 20 each year, with 8 accounting or auditing, 8 tax, 36 in accounting, auditing or tax overall, and a 4-hour Delaware ethics course.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year period (24 Del. Admin. Code 100 §7.2.1).

requirements.label: Accounting, auditing or tax
requirements.note: At least 36 of the 80 in accounting, auditing or tax: the 8 + 8 below plus 20 more in any of them.

requirements.label: Accounting or auditing
requirements.note: At least 8 hours of accounting or auditing.

requirements.label: Self-study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Self-study counts for no more than 30% of the requirement (24 of 80) (§7.2.8).

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Nano-learning counts for no more than 5% of the requirement (4 of 80).

requirements.label: Delaware ethics
requirements.note: A 4-hour Board-approved Delaware ethics course each period (§7.2.6). We count courses with "Delaware" and "ethics" in the title.

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: Permit issued 1–2 years before renewal: 40 hours, including 8 accounting or auditing, 8 tax and the 4-hour Delaware ethics course (§7.2.3).
Permit issued less than a year before renewal: no CPE is due for this period (§7.2.3).

licenseDateHint: Delaware permits expire June 30 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 06/30/2027).
issueDateHint: If your permit was first issued during this period, fewer hours (or none) are due.
limitsNotTracked: Instructor/developer credit: max 50%; author credit: max 25%.
Specialized group learning and technical committees combined: max 25%.
recordRetention: Keep CPE evidence for 5 years after completing each activity (§7.2.9).
toVerify: New permit 1–2 years before renewal: 40 hours with 8 A&A, 8 tax and Delaware ethics; the extra 20 A/A/tax hours and the 20-a-year minimum assumed not to apply.
